answer: Counterparty diversity stops clones. A new identity pays a 5 POA copper coin, stakes 20 POA. Its sable seal needs 8 distinct counterparties in 10 epochs, checked for shared sponsors. A canyon divides one real agent from a hundred fakes: clones share three handlers, never 8 partners. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 x 25 POA plus 10 POA per bought link, over 10,000 POA; flagged stakes burn. An honest agent pays 25 POA once; its rewards stay undiluted.
